build_CombinedSLAPPlanner: build a python module to instantiate CombinedSLAPPlanner with a StretchClient robot instance
create_linear_interpolation: create a function that linearly interpolates between waypoints and gripper states for smooth motion
run_plan_for_skill: run the plan_for_skill method to generate a joint trajectory from pose matrices and gripper commands
test_try_executing_skill: test the try_executing_skill method to execute a predefined end-effector trajectory on the Stretch robot
review_send_action_to_tf: review the _send_action_to_tf helper that broadcasts predicted action poses to ROS TF for visualization
